description: Vietnam's electronic funds transfer reports, evaluated per transaction (Circular 09/2023/TT-NHNN, replaced by Circular 27/2025/TT-NHNN from 1 November 2025, which keeps the thresholds): a domestic transfer of 500,000,000 VND or more, or the equivalent in foreign currency, and an international transfer of 1,000 USD or more, or the equivalent in another currency; deadline of Article 37(1) of the Anti-Money Laundering Law 14/2022/QH15 (one working day). A transfer is international when the counterparty's country is set and is not VN; the bank must set it for every cross-border payment. This table reports transfers both out and in; which institution reports which side, and the effective date of the international threshold, are to be confirmed against the circular and the official gazette

rules.description: A domestic transfer, out or in, of 500,000,000 VND or more
A transfer to or from another country, out or in, of 1,000 USD or more
